examples.text: Avner Aliphas, M.D. - Dr. Aliphas graduated from The John Hopkins University with an undergraduate degree in Biomedical Engineering and Computer Science. He then completed a Master’s Degree in Biomedical Engineering from Boston University. He started his medical training at the University of Pennsylvania School of Medicine. He completed his internship in General Surgery, and residency and chief administrative resident year in Otolaryngology at the Boston Medical Center before joining the staff at Newton-Wellesley Hospital. Dr. Aliphas continues his affiliation with Boston University School of Medicine as an Assistant Professor of Otolaryngology - teaching residents in didactics and various clinical settings. Dr. Aliphas is board certified in Otolaryngology including sinus/allergy and otologic disease. Dr. Aliphas enjoys spending time with his wife and three boys as well as playing ice hockey, cycling and swimming.
